browser.scope: Full84 passed plus26 deliberate browser assignment skips. Targeted10 are overlapping requalification, never added as94 unique full tests. Functional concurrency has no FPS claim.

clean.scope: Independent fresh npm ci/build/full test; three build files byte-identical. Separate1000 batch is reproducibility evidence, not additional unique coverage.

resultLayout.scope: Real normal victory then viewport/DOM scrolling checks; physical Ctrl zoom and human recognition remain separate.

performance.scope: Ten active minutes, about five per real quality UI setting; source-b plus retained source retain real open production, 24 living actors with three real immune cells captured in both modes, accepted cell hits, frame budget and natural heap/DOM samples. Natural memory still requires trend review; this does not close M16 memory/native-device or playtest acceptance by itself.

countScopes.polling: cellHits deduplicates PROTOCOL_BEACON_HIT logs during measurement without joining each positive TARGET_HIT. It is not strictly an accepted-damage lower bound.
countScopes.acceptedMetric: runMetrics.finalSummary.control.beaconBites uses the actual accepted-damage accumulator across the whole case including setup and warmup, not only the600 measured seconds.
countScopes.frames: maxFrameEntries is observed across read snapshots, not every-tick occupancy.
countScopes.wallTime: The original wallDurationMs stops before post-measurement memory checks; wrapper execution.outerWallDurationMs includes the entire subprocess.

preservedHistory.scope: CandidateC baseline is historical evidence; its actual failures and build identity are retained. Current results do not rewrite it.

limitations: Five-player standardized blind testing0/5; user feedback remains a separate real record.
Scripted routes do not prove first-play timing, comprehension, fun, voluntary replay or incubation/commercial value.
Finite local headless performance and memory observations do not prove all-device performance or no leaks.
Native OS focus/minimize and physical Ctrl zoom remain unverified.
No configured Git remote: focused local dev-zbj commits remain unpushed.
